description: Transaction Decode (Base by default; chain= ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, avalanche): what did this transaction actually do, in plain English. Status, confirmations, function called, every token transfer (symbol + amount), approvals (UNLIMITED approvals flagged), NFT moves, fee, time, and whether it was an x402 payment (EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization). For agents checking a payment, a refund, or what a contract just did with their money. Public chain data, never needs a key. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/tx/decode, $0.002 via x402.)
